hotspots.title: Trump Midterm Rally Frenzy
hotspots.blurb: President Trump and top GOP figures are crisscrossing key swing states, holding high‑energy rallies in Nebraska, Texas, Ohio and beyond to energize the base ahead of the midterms.
hotspots.affect: The nonstop rally schedule fuels outrage‑filled headlines, triumphal framing and a sense that the election’s outcome hangs on these events.

hotspots.title: Trump‑Funded Ad Controversy
hotspots.blurb: Trump’s super PAC announced it will foot the bill for a wave of taxpayer‑funded television ads, prompting heated debate over legality, ethics and the use of public money for campaign messaging.
hotspots.affect: The story is charged with accusations of corruption, moral outrage and intense partisan sparring over the propriety of the ads.

hotspots.title: Vance Alaska Rally Surge
hotspots.blurb: Vice President JD Vance has made a high‑profile push in Alaska, holding multiple rallies in Fairbanks and Anchorage to boost Republican Senate and House candidates in toss‑up races.
hotspots.affect: The coverage is intense with partisan framing, claims of electoral stakes, and frequent mentions of protester confrontations, amplifying the sense of a pivotal battle.
